description: This file defines the class `IRefFontTable`, which represents an indirect reference to a font table in an OpenType font. It provides methods for preparing the font table for compilation and writing its binary data, used within the PDFsharp library for processing fonts in PDF documents.

classes.name: IRefFontTable
classes.description: Represents an indirect reference to an existing font table in a font image, used for creating binary copies of font tables without modification.

methods.name: PrepareForCompilation
methods.description: Prepares the font table for inclusion into its binary form by setting its length and checksum.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the binary representation of the font table to the provided font writer.
